invariants: corpus/questions.json must contain exactly expected.total entries
per-split counts must match expected.by_split exactly
the staging drafts must contain exactly approved_drafts.total approved items with matching per-split counts
no rejected id may appear in the partition or among approved drafts
purpose: Exact expected census of the worker-visible question partition. This file exists so a CONSISTENT truncation cannot pass: deleting staging drafts and the matching partition entries leaves every internal cross-check self-consistent, so only a pin held outside those artifacts can detect it. NOTE: this file lives INSIDE the repository, which makes it external to the artifacts it checks but NOT external to the repository. A commit that edits the data and this pin together defeats it. The trust root that actually holds is the digest of this file recorded OUTSIDE git, in <LMR_PRIVATE_EVAL_DIR>/freeze_census_pin.json, which stage 8 checks and fails closed on absence or disagreement.

rejected_quarantined.note: Authored, independently reviewed, and rejected on semantic grounds. Retained under staging/rejected/ and deliberately NOT published. Authored_total = expected.total + rejected_quarantined.count = 209.
